title: HateXScore: A Metric Suite for Evaluating Reasoning Quality in Hate Speech Explanations
reasoning: The paper includes 'Target-Group Identification (TGI)' as a core component of its metric suite, which benchmarks the ability of models to correctly identify protected groups in hate speech. This explicitly includes evaluating model performance regarding religious groups and affiliations as defined by various institutional policies (UN, Meta, Twitter, and YouTube) listed in the appendix.
